% Package watch (.github/workflows/nightly.yml): loads the packages the template patches, WITHOUT the
% template, and writes a fingerprint (MD5 of the definition) of every internal command it overrides, and
% whether every internal variable it uses still exists, to probe-fingerprints.txt. A changed line means a
% package update rewrote code the template patches: check that patch (the audit's patch inventory).
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en-GB, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={ua-2,a-4f}, tagging=on,
  tagging-setup={math/setup={mathml-SE,mathml-AF}}, colorprofiles={X=FOGRA39L_coated.icc}}

\ExplSyntaxOn
\iow_new:N \g__probe_iow
\cs_new_protected:Npn \__probe_cs:N #1
  {
    \iow_now:Ne \g__probe_iow
      {
        \token_to_str:N #1 \c_space_tl
        \cs_if_exist:NTF #1 { \str_mdfive_hash:e { \cs_meaning:N #1 } } { MISSING }
      }
  }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \__probe_exists:N #1
  { \iow_now:Ne \g__probe_iow { \token_to_str:N #1 \c_space_tl \cs_if_exist:NTF #1 { exists } { MISSING } } }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \__probe_name:n #1
  { \iow_now:Ne \g__probe_iow { #1 \c_space_tl \cs_if_exist:cTF {#1} { exists } { MISSING } } }
\cs_new_protected:Npn \__probe_socket:n #1
  { \iow_now:Ne \g__probe_iow { socket~#1 \c_space_tl \socket_if_exist:nTF {#1} { exists } { MISSING } } }
\AddToHook{begindocument/end}
  {
    \iow_open:Nn \g__probe_iow { probe-fingerprints.txt }
    % LaTeX kernel and latex-lab (tagging)
    \clist_map_inline:nn
      {

        \abx@MakeMarkcase, \blx@warn@bibempty, \@cancel, \@cancelto, \canto@vector,

        \__luamml_amsmath_save_tag_with_struct_elem:N, \__luamml_amsmath_set_tag:,
        \__luamml_amsmath_finalize_inner_table:

    \clist_map_inline:nn

        tagsupport/caption/begin, tagsupport/caption/end, tagsupport/sec/title/begin,
